Thanks — I see the screenshot, and sorry for the friction. Looping in Lauren to help with host/organizer transfer. Quick notes from ops:

- When our team creates the event from a different domain the calendar object sometimes loses the embedded join token for federated domains. Recreating the invite from the account that will actually host is the most reliable fix.
- If we use Zoom we can add alice@starchip.ai as an alternative host (requires her Zoom account to accept the role) — that should let her admit external users without SSO friction. For Meet, we can include her as co-host once the Meet is created from her G Suite org.

Plan: I'll leave the existing event live (so existing RSVPs don't get lost) and create a new invite from Mateo's calendar with the join link in the body; we'll then cancel the original event and send a short update so RSVPs map to the new invite. Lauren — can you confirm you can run the transfer and paste the join link into both the event and the meeting description?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
